negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D computer animation, shiny plastic skin, airbrushed digital art, flat 2D cartoon, biological real human face, baby fat cheeks, deformed hands, extra fingers, modern clothing, fluorescent lighting
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion material quality — porous clay skin, etched age creases, frizzy mohair wool, and coarse tweed weave — AI tends to render generic smooth digital skin
caricatured facial profile with smooth bald dome, bushy eyebrows, and oversized graceful hooked nose — AI often normalizes into generic old human proportions
shallow depth-of-field mirror reflection interplay — AI frequently renders the reflection equally sharp or ignores the optical plane difference
articulated clay hands with expressive wrinkles and fingernails adjusting coat lapels — AI often distorts hands into fused or mutated shapes
